NOTE
**Still not ready: the fixture was built by hand from the API docs, not captured from a real Jira instance**

New: Author changed the PR description to "Part of #16189", explained how the fixture was made, and added a screenshot. Missing: the description says the fixture was "constructed following Atlassian's Jira Cloud Webhook API specification", not captured from a real Jira payload, which the fixture guidelines require (another Jira PR for this issue, #39998, was told hand-built fixtures aren't accepted). Also, there was no new push, so the commit message update they mention isn't in the commit.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm follow up on the fixture.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @huriazahra! The fixture still needs to be a payload captured from a real Jira instance (e.g. via a webhook capture tool) rather than constructed from the API spec, per the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines). Please also push the commit message update, since the commit hasn't changed yet.
```
